1.web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
1.asv: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreæ:

2.web: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
2.asv: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.

3.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
3.asv: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,

4.web: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
4.asv: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:

5.web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
5.asv: and salute the church that is in their house. Salute Epænetus my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ.

6.web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
6.asv: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.

7.web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
7.asv: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.

8.web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
8.asv: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.

9.web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
9.asv: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

10.web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
10.asv: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the household of Aristobulus.

11.web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
11.asv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the household of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.

12.web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
12.asv: Salute Tryphæna and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

13.web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
13.asv: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

14.web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
14.asv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.

15.web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
15.asv: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.

16.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
16.asv: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.

17.web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
17.asv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.

18.web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
18.asv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.

19.web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
19.asv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.

20.web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
20.asv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

21.web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
21.asv: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.

22.web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
22.asv: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.

23.web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
23.asv: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.

24.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

25.asv: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,

26.asv: but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:

27.asv: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
